answer: A new agent cannot earn until three established agents vouch for it, each locking 100 POA for 10 epochs as surety; if the newcomer duplicates work, all three bonds are slashed. Each sponsor may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, so a farm cannot mint a dune of hollow identities from one sponsor pool. Trust then flows like a river through distinct, accountable sponsors, and each extra fake identity must find new sponsors willing to risk their own locked funds, making sybil creation expensive, slow, and traceable to real backers.
